When we were designing the packaging for Purity Beans, a veteran retail consultant gave us advice that sounds completely logical in the corporate FMCG world: 'Make the ingredient list as small as possible. Put it near the bottom fold. Nobody reads it anyway.'

For a week, we considered it. It saves space. It looks cleaner to modern minimalist standards. But it felt wrong for an Indian brand built on trust.

We realized that urban coffee drinkers are tired of squinting at fine print. When you buy morning coffee, you shouldn't need a magnifying glass to know what's in your cup. We threw out the tiny font and made our ingredient panel the centerpiece of the jar.

Today, transparency is our operating principle. Bold, Purista, Purica, and Prima are pure coffee with zero additives. Ultra Blend is formulated as a smooth 70% coffee and 30% chicory milk coffee. No guessing, no hidden fillers, just honest labeling.
